rationale: The discourse has stabilized around a structured comparison of no-closure versus partial-closure scenarios, but the core dispute remains unresolved: investors/management insist on potential site rationalization while labour, the works council, and the state still reject closures and compulsory redundancies. The last two rounds mainly repeated positions while asking for models that still have not been produced, so an expert-led synthesis of the actual savings gap would be more useful than another rhetorical round.
